subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-27
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/destinations/looker_studioAdded a new "Looker Studio alternative — or a live Looker Studio connector? ARLO is both" section: a feature-comparison table (setup, cost, data freshness, multi-client scale, ad-hoc questions, Claude access) and two "when to choose each" lists, right below the hero.looker studio alternativeaskarlo.app/destinations/looker_studio
/destinations/power_biSame comparison-section treatment: Power BI vs. ARLO feature table (setup, licensing, connections, refresh cadence, multi-client overhead, skill required) plus when-to-choose lists.power bi alternativeaskarlo.app/destinations/power_bi
/destinations/bigquerySame treatment, framed as "do you need a warehouse at all": BigQuery vs. ARLO feature table (setup, cost model, SQL vs. plain English, freshness, best-fit use case) plus when-to-choose lists.bigquery alternative for marketing reportingaskarlo.app/destinations/bigquery
All 15 /destinations/[slug] pagesAdded the dateModified field to each page's WebPage structured data — it was missing (only /compare pages had it), flagged separately in the same audit.schema completeness, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app/destinations/tableau

Why this instead of another blog post or new connector page: catalog.ts is still unchanged (mailchimp's Aug 2026 ETA is now due and still unshipped; everything else still overdue), and the connector matrix + comparison hub are both still fully caught up. This was the top item on the standing SXO audit's quick-win list: three destination pages were ranking-adjacent for "[tool] alternative" searches but only described how to feed ARLO's data into that tool — they never addressed someone deciding whether they need the tool at all. Framed honestly as serving both readers rather than pretending these are pure competitor teardowns.

Housekeeping: found the prior session's two commits sitting in a detached-HEAD state, not reachable from origin/main at session start. Turned out to be a stale local ref, not actual lost work (confirmed after a fresh git fetch) — but worth a heads up in case it happens for real next time.

Needs your attention (unchanged): mailchimp's catalog.ts ETA ("August 2026") is now due and still coming_soon — worth confirming ship status. Off-page link building is still 0 of 6 directories/registries (needs a human with a browser). GSC submission and the dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold decision are both still open from prior sessions.

Next: a weekly-pulse-style session (backlinks, CI status, catalog.ts re-check, full rank-position report) is due around 2026-08-28. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
